evidence.name: Screen field: Set the restore link boldness
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Set the restore link boldness" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Set the restore link boldness
sections.description: Controls how heavy the restore link text looks (for example Normal or Semibold). Use a normal weight so restore stays a quiet secondary link and doesn't pull attention from your purchase button. Bump it to semibold only if it's genuinely hard to read against the background.
